title: Eric's Widgets
description: Adds some handy little 1-block machines for the mechanically-minded crafter
body:
This mod will collect a few little utility blocks of use for building contraptions. 

For now, it contains one major tool - the Item Splitter. 

The Item Splitter, and its 3-way and 2-way variants, distribute inserted items evenly between their outputs. 

It works like a hopper, but also supports various mod item pipes and other methods of insertion. 

Item Splitter - evenly distributes inserted items between up to four outputs. The Item Splitter works like a hopper, but also supports various mod item pipes and other methods of insertion. 

![Item splitter with a single input chest splitting to two attached chests](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1db2ca198779a00f4f51463ea7333ae9ecddb4f.png)

Item Splitters are crafted from two intermediate items - the Splitter Input, and a varying number of Splitter Outputs. 

The Splitter Input is crafted with the following recipe: 
![Splitter Input Recipe - Iron, Hopper, Iron, Piston, Clock, Piston, Iron, Redstone, Iron](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e4aac3ab1b86d165ad154e47d55fb37751dc70c4.png)

The Splitter Output is crafted like this: 
![Splitter Output Recipe: Empty, Iron, Empty, Iron, Hopper, Iron, Empty, Empty, Empty](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ee9390f2e39a2e47c7f6e87d1eb7c5510687fd1e.png)

Splitter Input and Outputs are combined to produce variants of the Item Splitter: 

![4-way Item Splitter Recipe: Empty, Splitter Output, Empty, Splitter Output, Splitter Input, Splitter Output, Empty, Splitter Output, Empty](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df52232d0c279a87580b7d6e8541c6ac9e6ef139.png)

![3-way Item Splitter Recipe: Empty, Splitter Output, Empty, Splitter Output, Splitter Input, Splitter Output, Empty, Empty, Empty](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9b21abe44d59b2a076f1b1b2927523e8383489c.png)

![2-way Item Splitter Recipe: 3-way Item Splitter Recipe: Empty, Empty, Empty, Splitter Output, Splitter Input, Splitter Output, Empty, Empty, Empty](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/97c8bcc1fade8f4f77d97b044d79a228bfb7568b.png)
